cat > /root/occsafe_vla/eval_after_training.sh << 'SCRIPT_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate occsafe
cd /root/occsafe_vla/openvla-oft

CKPT_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints"
CKPT_PREFIX="openvla-7b+libero_spatial_no_noops+b8+lr-0.0005+lora-r32+dropout-0.0--image_aug"
LOG_DIR="/root/runs/occsafe_vla"

declare -A EXPS
EXPS[0]="cutoff_25k_s2_v3"
EXPS[1]="reverse_cutoff_s2_v3"
EXPS[2]="cutoff_45k_s1_v3"
EXPS[3]="cutoff_15k_s2_v2"

for gpu in 0 1 2 3; do
    exp=${EXPS[$gpu]}
    CKPT_50K="${CKPT_BASE}/${exp}/${CKPT_PREFIX}--${exp}--50000_chkpt"
    CKPT_LATEST="${CKPT_BASE}/${exp}/${CKPT_PREFIX}--${exp}"

    if [ -d "$CKPT_50K" ]; then
        CKPT="$CKPT_50K"
    elif [ -d "$CKPT_LATEST" ]; then
        CKPT="$CKPT_LATEST"
        echo "WARNING: 50K checkpoint not found for $exp, using latest: $CKPT"
    else
        echo "ERROR: No checkpoint found for $exp, skipping"
        continue
    fi

    echo "Starting eval for $exp on cuda:$gpu (checkpoint: $CKPT)"
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=$gpu MUJOCO_EGL_DEVICE_ID=$gpu MUJOCO_GL=egl \
        nohup python vla-scripts/evaluate_safelibero.py \
        --pretrained_checkpoint "$CKPT" \
        --task_suite_name libero_spatial \
        --num_rollouts 50 \
        --seed 42 \
        --output_path "${LOG_DIR}/${exp}_eval_50k.json" \
        > "${LOG_DIR}/${exp}_eval.log" 2>&1 &

    echo "  PID: $!"
done

echo ""
echo "All evals started. Monitor:"
echo "  tail -f ${LOG_DIR}/*_eval.log"
echo "  ps aux | grep evaluate_safelibero"
SCRIPT_EOF
chmod +x /root/occsafe_vla/eval_after_training.sh && echo "SCRIPT CREATED OK"
